Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Clearview is running a competitive RFP with two incumbents and a shortlisting window of 8 weeks. We'd like to include Redwood in a side-by-side evaluation that will include the following:
- 5 million tokens of mixed-text generation and embeddings workload

2) Allow a trial extension / roll-forward if the test window runs longer than 30 days

Hi Marta — great to meet you earlier.

We can support Clearview on a bake-off. Initial thoughts:
- We can provision an evaluation credit of 50,000 tokens immediately (no cost) to get the test started.
- Roll-forward/extensions beyond 30 days are possible but require a short mutual action plan and a credit usage cap to prevent abuse. For competitive RFPs we typically require:
  * Signed MA plan that outlines the evaluation scope and timeline
  * A small one-time security attestation (SOC2 summary) on file with procurement
- If you expect >500k tokens we should scope a paid pilot or a conditional top-up.

I have looped in Jordan (sales ops) to confirm details on duration and how we should tag the credits in HubSpot for reporting.
